# For AI agents

`brand` ships artifacts for coding agents alongside its code. This page lists
them, says where each lives in the repository, and points at the
machine-readable copies of this documentation.

## Skills

Skills are folders holding a `SKILL.md` (the [Agent Skills](https://agentskills.io) format): a description that tells an agent when to use it and a body with the procedure. Install one into your agent with `gh skill` (any host: `--agent claude-code`, `copilot`, `cursor`, `codex`, `gemini`), or use the copy bundled in the wheel.

### `brand-evaluate`

Evaluate, score, or assess one or more candidate brand names by combining the `brand` Python package’s quantitative pipeline (syllables, stress pattern, spelling transparency, sound symbolism, novelty, substring hazards, keyboard distance) with expert synthesis on pronounceability, memorability, emotional valence, sector flexibility, and visual appeal. Use when the user asks to evaluate, score, rate, or assess brand name candidates, or wants a verdict on a shortlist. For a full multi-agent comparative report on 5-15 names, prefer brand-name-report instead.

```bash
gh skill install thorwhalen/brand brand-evaluate --agent claude-code
```

Source: [`skills/brand-evaluate`](https://github.com/thorwhalen/brand/tree/HEAD/skills/brand-evaluate).

### `brand-generate`

Brainstorm, generate, suggest, or create candidate brand names using the `brand` package’s generators (combinatoric CVCVCV/pattern generation, morpheme combination, AI-assisted suggestion) and its quick_screen pipeline to rapidly filter and organize a shortlist by sound profile. Use when the user wants new name ideas rather than an evaluation of names they already have — asks to brainstorm, generate, suggest, or come up with brand/product/ package name candidates.

```bash
gh skill install thorwhalen/brand brand-generate --agent claude-code
```

Source: [`skills/brand-generate`](https://github.com/thorwhalen/brand/tree/HEAD/skills/brand-generate).

### `brand-name-report`

Generate a comprehensive brand name analysis report for a list of candidate names. Computes all available metrics from the brand package, launches parallel AI agents for individual name deep-dives, and compiles a formatted markdown report. Use when the user provides candidate brand names and wants a comparative analysis.

```bash
gh skill install thorwhalen/brand brand-name-report --agent claude-code
```

Source: [`skills/brand-name-report`](https://github.com/thorwhalen/brand/tree/HEAD/skills/brand-name-report).

### `brand-pipeline-designer`

Design a custom brand-name evaluation pipeline with the `brand` package by discovering the user’s needs (purpose, audience, required platform availability, tone, budget, candidate volume) and assembling Generate/Score/ Filter stages from the available generators and scorers, ordered cheap before expensive. Use when the user wants to design a custom pipeline, understand what stages/scorers/generators are available, modify an existing pipeline template, or plan a systematic large-scale name search rather than evaluate or generate names directly.

```bash
gh skill install thorwhalen/brand brand-pipeline-designer --agent claude-code
```

Source: [`skills/brand-pipeline-designer`](https://github.com/thorwhalen/brand/tree/HEAD/skills/brand-pipeline-designer).

### `brand-research`

Deep-dive research on one specific brand name candidate: etymology and morpheme breakdown, phonaesthetics, cross-linguistic safety (meanings and homophone collisions in other languages), competitive landscape (similar existing brands, domain/social-media availability, SEO crowding), cultural and historical context, and strategic brand-architecture assessment. Use when the user wants in-depth research on a specific name beyond the standard evaluation pipeline — cultural context, competitive landscape, etymology, or strategic positioning for one finalist candidate.

```bash
gh skill install thorwhalen/brand brand-research --agent claude-code
```

Source: [`skills/brand-research`](https://github.com/thorwhalen/brand/tree/HEAD/skills/brand-research).

## Subagents

Subagents are Markdown files with a frontmatter (`name`, `description`, `tools`) and a system prompt as the body. Copy one into your project’s `.claude/agents/` (or your agent host’s equivalent) to delegate the task it describes.

## Machine-readable documentation

This site publishes the same documentation in forms that fit an agent’s context window:

- [`llms.txt`](https://thorwhalen.github.io/brand/llms.txt): an index of every page with a one-line description ([llms.txt](https://llmstxt.org) format)
- [`brand.md`](https://thorwhalen.github.io/brand/brand.md): the whole documentation as one Markdown file
- `<page>.html.md`: a rendered Markdown twin of every page, advertised from each page’s `<head>` with `<link rel="alternate" type="text/markdown">`
- [`objects.inv`](https://thorwhalen.github.io/brand/objects.inv): the Sphinx inventory: a symbol-to-URL index (`sphobjinv convert plain objects.inv -`)
